messages:
Marta (CS): Drafting a concise customer-facing 'onboard smoke kit' for trial->prod. Goal: reproducible smoke tests, clear AM copy, a renewal pulse metric, and conservative prefill jitter guidance. PTAL.

Ken (AM): Love it. Customers need a tiny checklist and copy to paste. Can we add a short taxonomy for feedback tags (e.g., #quality, #latency, #cost)?

Marta (CS): Yes. Plan: 3 parts in the one-pager — 1) smoke test steps, 2) AM script + feedback tags, 3) ops knobs (prefill + jitter + safety budget).

Iris (SRE): Ops thumbs up. Suggest defaults and a pasteable batching/priming snippet. Also include guidance for jitter to avoid thundering herd: randomize prefill start within 0-90s, spread sample prompts across 5m window. Monitor p99 and prefix-cache hit%.

Felix (PM): Add a renewal pulse: a single number (0-100) computed from usage (30%), survey (30%), and sample-quality (40%). AMs set a qualitative flag (ok/watch/risk) and the system stores renewal_pulse. If <45, trigger 10-day outreach play.

Marta (CS): Draft smoke test steps: 
1) Run 6 canonical prompts (2 core intents, 2 edge, 2 failover) and capture outputs.
2) Measure p50/p95/p99 latency for those prompts.
3) Verify prefix-cache hit% >= 65% for the core intents.
4) Confirm no model fallback happened during the test.

Ken (AM): AM script (2 lines, copyable): 
- "We ran a short smoke test to make sure demos feel snappy — should take 2 minutes."
- "If anything looks off (latency/quality/cost) I can jump on a 15-min troubleshooting call."

Marta (CS): Feedback tag taxonomy for AMs to attach after calls: #quality, #latency, #cost, #integration, #ux. Tagging triggers automated workflows: #quality -> daily sample regression check; #latency -> spike monitor; #cost -> cost cap reminder.

Iris (SRE): Ops snippet to paste in runbook: 
```
# priming + batching defaults for smoke kit
priming:
  prefill_count: "6"           # small smoke test set
  prefill_window_min: "5"
  priming_ttl_min: "5"
prefill_jitter_sec: "0-90"   # randomize start to avoid bursts
batching:
  warm_window_ms: "25"
  steady_window_ms: "7"
  max_batch_tokens: "2048"
safety_budget_pct: "3"       # reserve percent for demos during the window
```

Marta (CS): Add a tiny JSON AM example to flip a smoke-kit and set renewal_pulse: 
```
{"tenant_id":"cust-246","smoke_kit_enabled":"true","smoke_started_at":"2025-03-10T15:04:00Z","renewal_pulse":"62"}
```

Felix (PM): Monitoring & alerts suggested in the one-pager: 
- Alert if p99 > 2x baseline for >2m -> tag #latency and notify SRE+AM
- Alert if core-prompt quality drops >4% -> tag #quality and notify AM
- Alert if safety_budget_pct consumed > 80% during demo -> tag #cost and reduce demo reservations

Iris (SRE): Troubleshooting quick hits for AMs to try before calling SRE: 
- Rerun smoke test after 2 minutes (jitter)
- Check prefix keys for core intents if kv hit% low
- If model fallback occurred, note model_family in the ticket

Ken (AM): I like the 2-line script and tags. I'll run this with two upcoming pilot customers and paste real-word feedback to replace placeholder prompts.

Marta (CS): Great. Plan: publish the one-pager + a Slack paste for AMs and add the smoke-kit toggle to the onboarding checklist. Will aim to ship by EOD Friday.

onboard-bot: Created doc 'onboard-smoke-kit-pulse-prefill-guidance' in #customer-success/docs  please review.

Felix (PM): Small follow-up: include a 'fast rollback' recipe: auto-fallback to smaller model family + an immediate smoke re-run and notify AM if p99 stays >2x baseline after rollback.

Iris (SRE): I'll validate the priming jitter in staging tonight and report back with the log snippet.

Marta (CS): Thanks all — I'll incorporate these edits and publish the final handout. :wave:
